Trump Didnt Actually Give Money to All His Debate Opponents

The lede:

While he speaking during the GOP primary debate, Donald Trump brought up how has given money to various political figures, including Hillary Clinton, in exchange for favors and privileges in the past. When he said that he has given money to his debate competitors, however, Marco Rubio, Mike Huckabee, and several others chimed in to say that they haven’t received a dime from him.

Ironically, Politifact has been tracking and calculating Trump’s political expenditures to others over the last month, and it turns out that eight of Trump’s opponents have never received a single dollar from the real estate mogul over the years.

The only exception is Jeb Bush, and Trump might’ve exaggerated the impact he had on that, for the numbers show that Bush received only $500.

If Trump was referring to all of his competition, he might have had a bit more to go on than he did on stage. When you include the GOP candidates from the “Happy Hour Debate”, numbers from The Washington Post indicate that Trump gave $43,500 to George Pataki, and $2,600 to Lindsey Graham.
